.github/workflows/bench-half-spike.yml.text:
name: GodPrompt Bench Half Spike

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - experiment/godprompt-half-2026-08-29
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/bench-half-spike.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  half-spike:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 120
    env:
      OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: bench/pyproject.toml

      - name: Install benchmark
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e './bench[test,openai]'

      - name: Verify clean pre-run tree
        shell: bash
        run: |
          status="$(git status --porcelain)"
          printf '%s\n' "$status"
          test -z "$status"

      - name: Verify frozen manifest preflight
        run: python -m pytest bench/tests/test_sandbox_config.py bench/tests/test_run.py -q

      - name: Build isolated task sandbox
        run: docker compose -f bench/sandbox/compose.yaml build

      - name: Simulate half scale with Inspect mock model
        run: |
          python -m godprompt_bench.run \
            --profile half \
            --model mockllm/model \
            --output bench/results-simulated-half

      - name: Run real frozen GPT-5.6 Sol smoke comparison when credential is configured
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if [ -z "$OPENAI_API_KEY" ]; then
            echo 'REAL_SMOKE_SKIPPED_NO_OPENAI_API_KEY=1'
            exit 0
          fi
          python -m godprompt_bench.run \
            --profile smoke \
            --model openai/gpt-5.6-sol \
            --seed 7 \
            --reasoning-effort medium \
            --reasoning-mode standard \
            --output bench/results-real-smoke

      - name: Upload spike artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: godprompt-bench-half-spike-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            bench/results-simulated-half
            bench/results-real-smoke
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7

.github/workflows/bench-run.yml.text:
name: Run GodPrompt Bench

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      profile:
        description: Benchmark profile
        type: choice
        options: [smoke, full]
        default: smoke
        required: true
      model:
        description: Inspect model identifier
        type: string
        default: openai/gpt-5.6-sol
        required: true
      reasoning_effort:
        description: Reasoning effort (must be supported by the selected model)
        type: choice
        options: [none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max]
        default: medium
        required: true
      reasoning_mode:
        description: Reasoning mode (must be supported by the selected model)
        type: choice
        options: [standard, pro]
        default: standard
        required: true
      seed:
        description: Random seed (must be supported by the selected provider)
        type: string
        default: '7'
        required: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 360
    env:
      OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: bench/pyproject.toml

      - name: Require configured OpenAI credential
        if: startsWith(inputs.model, 'openai/')
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if [ -z "$OPENAI_API_KEY" ]; then
            echo 'OPENAI_API_KEY secret is required for OpenAI benchmark runs.' >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Install benchmark
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e './bench[openai]'

      - name: Build isolated task sandbox
        run: docker compose -f bench/sandbox/compose.yaml build

      - name: Run benchmark
        run: |
          python -m godprompt_bench.run \
            --profile '${{ inputs.profile }}' \
            --model '${{ inputs.model }}' \
            --seed '${{ inputs.seed }}' \
            --reasoning-effort '${{ inputs.reasoning_effort }}' \
            --reasoning-mode '${{ inputs.reasoning_mode }}' \
            --output bench/results

      - name: Upload benchmark artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: godprompt-bench-${{ inputs.profile }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: bench/results
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30

.github/workflows/bench-verify.yml.text:
name: Verify GodPrompt Bench

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  verify-benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: bench/pyproject.toml

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: '22.18.0'

      - name: Install benchmark
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e './bench[test]'

      - name: Verify GodPrompt source sync
        run: python build.py --check

      - name: Run benchmark tests
        run: python -m pytest bench/tests -q

      - name: Build isolated task sandbox
        run: docker compose -f bench/sandbox/compose.yaml build

      - name: Verify sandbox runtime
        run: |
          docker compose -f bench/sandbox/compose.yaml run --rm default sh -lc '
            test "$(id -u)" -ne 0 &&
            python3 --version &&
            node --version
          '
